name: SiteLayout
summary: A website's page: the site header at the top (it stays while the page scrolls, on the chrome material: frosted when the setting is on, with its hairline only while content is under it), the page's parts in one centred column spaced as sections, and the footer across the full width. The window scrolls; the margins hold at every width. Not for an app with its own panes (ChatLayout, ListDetail) or for documentation with a side navigation (LibraryLayout).
a11y: A skip link first, to the `main` landmark; the header slot sits in a `banner` (`header`) landmark and the Footer brings its own `contentinfo`. The column's parts keep their own headings; give the page one level-1 heading (usually the Hero's).

props.name: header
props.description: The SiteHeader. It stays at the top while the page scrolls.

props.name: children
props.description: The page's parts in order: a Hero, then Sections. The layout gives them one column and the space between them.

props.name: footer
props.description: The Footer, the full width of the window under the column.

props.name: width
props.description: `wide` (default): a landing page's 72 rem column; `reading`: an article's measure, for long text.

props.name: skipLabel
props.description: The skip link's words: "Skip to content" (default).
